sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们还是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你带来终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.zh: 今天是周五。

sentences.en: It's not Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 不是周三。

sentences.zh: 我们出现在你的订阅源里了。

sentences.zh: 在周五。

sentences.zh: 在周五。

sentences.zh: 感谢上帝，终于周五了。

sentences.en: We have a way to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 我们有一种庆祝方式。

sentences.en: We hope you like it.
sentences.zh: 希望你会喜欢。

sentences.en: We are going to play for you the entire first chapter of our audiobook of The Office BFFs.
sentences.zh: 我们将为你播放我们的有声书《办公室闺蜜》的第一章全文。

sentences.en: So happy Friday.
sentences.zh: 所以，周五快乐。

sentences.en: Hang out with us for a little bit, and we hope you have a great weekend.
sentences.zh: 和我们一起待一会儿吧，祝你周末愉快。

sentences.en: Chapter 1.
sentences.zh: 第一章。

sentences.en: Job Opening.
sentences.zh: 职位空缺。

sentences.en: Office Work.
sentences.zh: 办公室工作。

sentences.en: In 2003, a group of strangers had one very big thing in common.
sentences.zh: 2003年，一群陌生人有一个共同点。

sentences.en: We had all just been cast on a new TV comedy pilot called The Office.
sentences.zh: 我们都刚被选中出演一部名为《办公室》的新喜剧试播集。

sentences.en: After years of living as struggling artists, we were all very happy to be employed in doing what we loved.
sentences.zh: 在经历了多年挣扎的艺术家生活后，我们都非常高兴能从事自己热爱的工作。

sentences.en: We could never have predicted the impact it would have on the rest of our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们当时绝不可能预见到它会对我们余生造成多大的影响。

sentences.en: I have an old photo from my first day of work on The Office.
sentences.zh: 我有一张在《办公室》工作第一天的老照片。

sentences.en: It was taken when Steve Carell, John Krasinski, Rainn Wilson, BJ Novak, David Denman, Phyllis Smith, and I met with the producers,
sentences.zh: 那是史蒂夫·卡瑞尔、约翰·卡拉辛斯基、雷恩·威尔森、B.J.诺瓦克、大卫·丹曼、菲利斯·史密斯和我与制片人见面时拍的，

sentences.en: network executives showrunner greg daniels and director ken kwapas to do a table read of the
sentences.zh: 电视网高管、剧集主创格雷格·丹尼尔斯和导演肯·卡皮斯第一次进行

sentences.en: pilot script for the very first time allison jones our casting director came to the table
sentences.zh: 试播集剧本围读。我们的选角导演艾莉森·琼斯带着

sentences.en: read armed with a plate of homemade chocolate chip cookies and a polaroid camera i desperately wanted
sentences.zh: 一盘自制巧克力曲奇和一台拍立得相机来到围读现场。我非常渴望

sentences.en: a picture to commemorate the day and this was before everyone had cameras on their phones
sentences.zh: 拍张照片来纪念这一天，那是在大家手机里都有摄像头之前。

sentences.en: So I was excited when she told us all to gather together for a photo.
sentences.zh: 所以当她叫我们聚在一起拍照时，我很兴奋。

sentences.en: I asked if she would take one for me, too.
sentences.zh: 我问她能不能也帮我拍一张。

sentences.en: She said sure, took a second picture, and handed me the Polaroid and a cookie.
sentences.zh: 她说没问题，拍了第二张，然后把拍立得照片和一块曲奇递给了我。

sentences.en: I remember standing and munching the cookie while watching the photo slowly develop before my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时一边站着吃曲奇，一边看着照片在眼前慢慢显影。

sentences.en: To let you know how special this whole moment was, let me share a little about my backstory.
sentences.zh: 为了让你了解这一刻有多特别，让我分享一点我的背景故事。

sentences.en: I grew up in St. Louis, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 我在密苏里州圣路易斯长大。

sentences.en: From the time I was seven years old, I knew I wanted to be an actor.
sentences.zh: 从七岁起，我就知道我想成为一名演员。

sentences.en: I can't say why exactly, but I barely remember a time when this wasn't my goal.
sentences.zh: 我说不出具体原因，但我几乎不记得什么时候我没有这个目标。

sentences.en: At age nine, I considered becoming a veterinarian, but when I learned I would have to do surgeries on animals, I went back to my original plan of actor.
sentences.zh: 九岁时，我考虑过当兽医，但当我得知必须给动物做手术时，我又回到了最初的演员计划。

sentences.en: My parents were very supportive, but also refused to let me act professionally as a child.
sentences.zh: 我的父母非常支持我，但也拒绝让我童年时期就从事专业表演。

sentences.en: And it's not like there were a ton of opportunities in St. Louis, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，圣路易斯也没有那么多机会。

sentences.en: They told me I had to graduate from high school and college before moving to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，必须高中和大学毕业后才能搬到洛杉矶。

sentences.en: So, I auditioned for every school play and joined every drama club.
sentences.zh: 所以，我参加了每一场学校戏剧的试镜，并加入了每一个戏剧社。

sentences.en: I spent most of high school in the dancing chorus,
sentences.zh: 我的高中大部分时间都在舞蹈合唱团度过，

sentences.en: until my senior year when I was cast as the fiddler in The Fiddler on the Roof.
sentences.zh: 直到高三那年，我被选中在《屋顶上的提琴手》中饰演提琴手。

sentences.en: I had no lines but extra solo dancing.
sentences.zh: 我没有台词，但有额外的独舞。

sentences.en: I went to college at a small liberal arts school in rural Missouri
sentences.zh: 我去了密苏里州农村的一所小型文理学院上大学，

sentences.en: called Truman State University and majored in theater.
sentences.zh: 名叫杜鲁门州立大学，主修戏剧。

sentences.en: I learned a lot about acting technique, and my love of performing was solidified.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多表演技巧，我对表演的热爱也因此变得更加坚定。

sentences.en: After graduation, I packed up my Mazda 323 hatchback and drove across the country to Los Angeles, ready to give it a go in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，我收拾好我的马自达323掀背车，一路开车横跨全国来到洛杉矶，准备在好莱坞闯荡一番。

sentences.en: I ended up spending years in various odd jobs, trying to pay off my defaulted credit card and make my rent.
sentences.zh: 我最终在各种零工中度过了几年，努力偿还逾期的信用卡账单并支付房租。

sentences.en: Thanks to a mandatory typing class in high school, most of the jobs I found were working as, wait for it, a receptioniSt.
sentences.zh: 多亏了高中时的一门必修打字课，我找到的大多数工作都是——等着听好了——前台接待员。

sentences.en: In the meantime, I was going on hundreds of auditions and performing Commedia dell'arte with a local theater company.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我参加了数百场试镜，并与一家当地剧团一起表演意大利即兴喜剧。

sentences.en: I earned my Screen Actors Guild card doing background work, experience that would come in handy later, as you will learn in this book,
sentences.zh: 我通过做背景演员拿到了演员工会的会员卡，这段经历后来派上了用场，正如你们在这本书里将会读到的那样，

sentences.en: and each year I seemed to do a little better than the year before.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎每一年我都比前一年做得好一点点。

sentences.en: I booked some guest appearances on television shows, a couple of independent films, and a pilot called Rubbing Charlie.
sentences.zh: 我获得了一些电视剧的客串机会，参演了几部独立电影，还有一部名为《按摩查理》的试播集。

sentences.en: Yes, you heard that right.
sentences.zh: 没错，你没听错。

sentences.en: It was a comedy starring a stressed-out doctor named Charlie, played by Scott Wolfe,
sentences.zh: 那是一部喜剧，由斯科特·沃尔夫饰演一位名叫查理的压力巨大的医生，

sentences.en: who gets life lessons from his massage therapist, me.
sentences.zh: 他从他的按摩师——也就是我——那里获得了人生经验。

sentences.en: I actually rubbed Charlie.
sentences.zh: 我确实给查理做过按摩。

sentences.en: It was a really sweet and funny show.
sentences.zh: 那是一部非常温馨有趣的剧。

sentences.en: I was convinced it would be my big break.
sentences.zh: 我当时确信这就是我的成名作。

sentences.en: So when it didn't make it past the pilot stage, I was crushed.
sentences.zh: 所以当它没能通过试播阶段时，我深受打击。

sentences.en: I told my manager I wanted to quit, the years of rejection having taken their toll,
sentences.zh: 我告诉我的经纪人我想放弃，多年的拒绝已经让我不堪重负，

sentences.en: and my new plan was to apply to vet technician school,
sentences.zh: 我新的计划是申请兽医技术员学校，

sentences.en: animal care with no surgeries.
sentences.zh: 照顾动物，不用做手术。

sentences.en: She told me to keep at it,
sentences.zh: 她让我坚持下去，

sentences.en: that the right role would find me if I just didn't give up.
sentences.zh: 说只要我不放弃，合适的角色终会找到我。

sentences.en: I had my doubts.
sentences.zh: 我对此深表怀疑。

sentences.en: At that point, I'd been plugging away in Los Angeles
sentences.zh: 那时，我在洛杉矶已经摸爬滚打了

sentences.en: for nearly eight years,
sentences.zh: 近八年了，

sentences.en: but I decided to take her advice and give it one more year.
sentences.zh: 但我还是决定听从她的建议，再试一年。

sentences.en: As fate would have it, the following pilot season,
sentences.zh: 命运使然，在接下来的试播季，

sentences.en: I was asked to audition for the American remake
sentences.zh: 我被邀请去为BBC剧集《办公室》的美国翻拍版

sentences.en: of a BBC show called The Office.
sentences.zh: 进行试镜。

sentences.en: The role was for the receptionist, Pam,
sentences.zh: 那个角色是前台接待员帕姆，

sentences.en: a worn-down yet still hopeful young woman
sentences.zh: 一个疲惫不堪却依然心怀希望的年轻女性，

sentences.en: with artistic dreams beyond her depressing day job.
sentences.zh: 在令人沮丧的日常工作之外，还怀揣着艺术梦想。

sentences.en: In other words, me.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是我本人。

sentences.en: After we snapped the shot, Steve Carell said,
sentences.zh: 拍完那张照片后，史蒂夫·卡瑞尔说，

sentences.en: one day this photo will be worth money,
sentences.zh: 总有一天这张照片会很值钱，

sentences.en: especially after they fire me
sentences.zh: 尤其是在他们解雇我，

sentences.en: and replace me with a new actor for episode two.
sentences.zh: 并在第二集换上新演员之后。

sentences.en: You'll all look at this and say,
sentences.zh: 你们所有人看着这张照片会说，

sentences.en: aw, remember Steve, what's his name?
sentences.zh: 噢，还记得史蒂夫吗，叫什么来着？

sentences.en: He was sweet.
sentences.zh: 他挺可爱的。

sentences.en: I wonder what he's up to now.
sentences.zh: 不知道他现在在干什么。

sentences.en: Before The Office, Steve had the most experience of all of us.
sentences.zh: 在《办公室》之前，史蒂夫是我们所有人中经验最丰富的。

sentences.en: He wasn't a household name by any means, but he had been a correspondent on The Daily Show,
sentences.zh: 他绝非家喻户晓，但他曾是《每日秀》的通讯员，

sentences.en: he'd been a regular on The Dana Carvey Show,
sentences.zh: 也曾是《达纳·卡维秀》的常驻嘉宾，

sentences.en: and he'd had a scene-stealing role opposite Jim Carrey in the movie Bruce Almighty.
sentences.zh: 还在电影《冒牌天神》中与金·凯瑞演过对手戏，表现抢眼。

sentences.en: He had also been rejected by Saturday Night Live and been cast in more than one failed pilot.
sentences.zh: 他也曾被《周六夜现场》拒绝过，并出演过不止一部失败的试播集。

sentences.en: He knew better than all of us how rough and random our business could be.
sentences.zh: 他比我们任何人都更清楚这个行业有多么残酷和随机。

sentences.en: rain wilson had been knocking around for about 10 years traveling the country doing shakespeare
sentences.zh: 雷恩·威尔森已经在演艺圈闯荡了大约10年，在全国各地巡演莎士比亚剧目，

sentences.en: and most recently worked as a recurring character on six feet under phyllis had spent the previous
sentences.zh: 最近在《六尺之下》中饰演一个常驻角色。菲利斯此前已经

sentences.en: 19 years working in casting including eight as a casting associate for allison jones
sentences.zh: 在选角行业工作了19年，其中包括在艾莉森·琼斯手下担任选角助理的8年。

sentences.en: when we all came in to audition for the office phyllis was our reader ken kwapas was so taken
sentences.zh: 当我们都来为《办公室》试镜时，菲利斯担任我们的搭戏演员。肯·卡瓦皮斯对她印象深刻，

sentences.en: with her he told showrunner greg daniels he thought she should play a role on the show
sentences.zh: 他告诉剧集主创格雷格·丹尼尔斯，他认为她应该在剧中扮演一个角色。

sentences.en: John Krasinski had done some commercials, and like me, his last pilot was not picked up.
sentences.zh: 约翰·卡拉辛斯基拍过一些广告，和我一样，他上一部试播的剧集也没被选中。

sentences.en: BJ Novak had been doing stand-up comedy when Greg discovered him.
sentences.zh: BJ·诺瓦克在被格雷格发掘时，一直都在做单口喜剧表演。

sentences.en: David Denman was like Steve.
sentences.zh: 大卫·丹曼就像史蒂夫一样。

sentences.en: He'd been an employed yet mostly unknown actor for years,
sentences.zh: 他做了多年有戏拍但名不见经传的演员，

sentences.en: having appeared in a number of studio films and miniseries.
sentences.zh: 出演过不少电影制片厂的电影和迷你剧。

sentences.en: He'd also done four pilots, none of which ever made it to series.
sentences.zh: 他还拍过四部试播集，但没有一部最终被预订成剧集。

sentences.en: We all laughed at Steve's joke, but the truth is,
sentences.zh: 我们都对史蒂夫的笑话笑了，但说实话，

sentences.en: we were all also secretly wondering if we'd get to episode two.
sentences.zh: 我们私下里也都在怀疑自己能不能拍到第二集。

sentences.en: Also there that day were the creators of the original version of The Office,
sentences.zh: 那天在场的还有原版《办公室》的创作者，

sentences.en: Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇·热维斯和斯蒂芬·莫昌特。

sentences.en: I had watched every episode of the British series and naturally was a huge fan.
sentences.zh: 我看过英剧版的每一集，自然是他们的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: I was in awe of Lucy Davis's portrayal of Dawn, Pam's British counterpart.
sentences.zh: 露西·戴维斯饰演的道恩——也就是帕姆的英国原型——让我深感敬佩。

sentences.en: She could communicate so much with just a glance.
sentences.zh: 她仅凭一个眼神就能传达出丰富的内容。

sentences.en: I hoped that I could bring as much heart and depth to Pam as Lucy did to Dawn.
sentences.zh: 我希望自己能像露西赋予道恩那样，为帕姆注入同样多的情感和深度。

sentences.en: As I sat with the creators of this masterpiece, I remember thinking,
sentences.zh: 当我与这部杰作的创作者坐在一起时，我记得我当时想，

sentences.en: if I lose this job tomorrow, at least I got to sit in the same room as Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant.
sentences.zh: 如果我明天就丢了这份工作，至少我曾和瑞奇·热维斯与斯蒂芬·莫昌特坐在同一个房间里。

sentences.en: After the read, Ricky and Stephen gave us ideas for how to best Americanize the show.
sentences.zh: 剧本朗读会后，瑞奇和斯蒂芬为我们提供了如何将该剧本土化为美版的建议。

sentences.en: This had been the subject of a lot of discussion amongst the creative team.
sentences.zh: 这一直是创作团队讨论的重点。

sentences.en: In England, they do much shorter television seasons.
sentences.zh: 在英国，他们的电视播出季要短得多。

sentences.en: The original Office series was only 12 episodes long in total,
sentences.zh: 原版《办公室》总共只有12集，

sentences.en: with one Christmas special.
sentences.zh: 外加一集圣诞特辑。

sentences.en: American networks expect a lot more than that.
sentences.zh: 美国电视网的预期要高得多。

sentences.en: A typical American television show makes 24 episodes per season.
sentences.zh: 一部典型的美剧每季要拍24集。

sentences.en: Ricky noted that if we hoped to make 100 episodes,
sentences.zh: 瑞奇指出，如果我们希望能拍到100集，

sentences.en: we should be sure people didn't become too frustrated by Michael's incompetence.
sentences.zh: 就得确保观众不会对迈克尔的无能感到过于沮丧。

sentences.en: He suggested we make him a buffoon,
sentences.zh: 他建议把迈克尔塑造成一个丑角，

sentences.en: but still good at his job.
sentences.zh: 但同时在工作上依然称职。

sentences.en: That way, American viewers would find something
sentences.zh: 这样一来，美国观众就能在迈克尔的所有讨人厌之处中，

sentences.en: to admire in Michael amidst all the annoyance.
sentences.zh: 找到值得钦佩的地方。

sentences.en: Stephen Merchant then said
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·莫昌特随后表示，

sentences.en: that the Jim and Pam relationship
sentences.zh: 吉姆和帕姆的关系

sentences.en: was another way to balance Michael's obnoxious behavior.
sentences.zh: 是平衡迈克尔令人反感的行为的另一种方式。

sentences.en: He said, always remember,
sentences.zh: 他说，永远要记住，

sentences.en: Jim and Pam are the heart of the show.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和帕姆是这部剧的核心。

sentences.en: Gulp, no pressure.
sentences.zh: 天哪，压力山大。

sentences.en: I did not grow up in Los Angeles either.
sentences.zh: 我也不是在洛杉矶长大的。

sentences.en: I grew up in Indonesia by way of Louisiana and Texas,
sentences.zh: 我是在印度尼西亚长大的，之前还住过路易斯安那州和德克萨斯州，

sentences.en: My dad was a drilling engineer, and we moved around for his job.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是钻井工程师，我们因为他的工作搬来搬去。

sentences.en: I always knew I wanted to be a performer.
sentences.zh: 我一直都知道自己想成为一名表演者。

sentences.en: My mom loves to tell the story about when she asked me and my older sisters what we
sentences.zh: 我妈妈很喜欢讲那个故事：她问我和我的姐姐们，

sentences.en: wanted to be when we grew up.
sentences.zh: 长大后想做什么。

sentences.en: All my sisters had funny responses, but mine, she said, was the most puzzling.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐们的回答都很有趣，但她说，我的回答最让人费解。

sentences.en: My sister, Billie, said she wanted to be, quote, the boss.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐比莉说她想做“老板”。

sentences.en: Janet wanted to be a truck driver like our Uncle Carl, Tina, a gymnast, and I wanted to
sentences.zh: 珍妮特想像卡尔叔叔那样当卡车司机，蒂娜想当体操运动员，而我则想

sentences.en: be Carol Burnett.
sentences.zh: 成为卡罗尔·伯内特。

sentences.en: I was four.
sentences.zh: 那时我才四岁。

sentences.en: No one could know that we were related.
sentences.zh: 没人能知道我们有亲戚关系。

sentences.en: Greg felt strongly that letting this information get out to the network would only hurt my chances.
sentences.zh: 格雷格坚信，让电视台知道这个消息只会损害我的机会。

sentences.zh: 我们决定在试镜时装作互不认识。

sentences.zh: 他能帮我争取到面试机会，但我必须靠自己征服面试官。

sentences.en: I later learned that this ruse was Allison Jones's idea.
sentences.zh: 后来我才知道，这个计策是艾莉森·琼斯的主意。

sentences.en: She was a big champion of mine and had told Greg this was the best plan.
sentences.zh: 她是我的头号支持者，并告诉格雷格这是最好的计划。

sentences.en: Thank you, Allison!
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，艾莉森！

sentences.en: Yep, fact.

sentences.zh: 我非常清楚地记得我的试镜过程。

sentences.en: It's weird how the brain captures the biggest moments of your life and slows them down.
sentences.zh: 大脑捕捉人生中最重大的时刻并将其放慢，这真的很奇妙。

sentences.en: Every single detail is stuck in my brain.

sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·哈恩正坐在角落的沙发上。

sentences.en: We smiled at each other and said hello.
sentences.zh: 我们微笑着向对方打了招呼。

sentences.en: She is a doll and so talented, I tried my best not to get anxious.
sentences.zh: 她是个甜心，而且非常有才华，我尽力让自己不要焦虑。

sentences.en: I am not sweaty by nature.
sentences.zh: 我天生不容易出汗。

sentences.en: I usually run cold no matter the temperature.
sentences.zh: 无论气温如何，我通常都觉得冷。

sentences.zh: 但随着轮到我的时间越来越近，我真的开始冒汗了。

sentences.zh: 布景师在我的桌上放了一个蓝色陶瓷猫形回形针座。

sentences.en: The cat's left ear was slightly chipped, and I loved that little detail.
sentences.zh: 猫的左耳有一点缺口，我很喜欢这个小细节。

sentences.en: It looked like a knick-knack you would get from a garage sale in a small town.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像那种你在小镇旧货摊上买到的小摆件。

sentences.en: That cat paperclip holder did a lot to inform who Angela Martin was.
sentences.zh: 那个猫形回形针座对塑造安吉拉·马丁这个角色起到了很大的作用。

sentences.en: It was clear to me that she must love cats

sentences.zh: 而且她不需要昂贵的新东西就能感到快乐。

sentences.en: She was too humble for fancy, in a judgmental way, of course.
sentences.zh: 她为人太谦逊，以至于显得有些虚伪，当然，这是带着批判眼光的看法。
